verdict.rationale: An interactive high-integrity PowerShell process (PID 1200) loaded credential-related DLLs (cryptdll, samlib, vaultcli, WinSCard, hid) and opened lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1010 twice, with whoami /user run in between. This pattern matches Mimikatz-style LSASS credential dumping (e.g. sekurlsa::logonpasswords), although the lab setup (Sysmon install, eventvwr.exe launching mmc.exe) suggests a test environment.
